title: Common settings for every base, with a per-base override
goal: Settings edited once on the main base reach every base over the Kaji line; a base may override a value and the dashboard shows which
acceptance: Regression test across two linked bases: a common change reaches the other base, signed; an override wins on that base only; an unsigned or foreign settings record is refused
Owner confirms one common change on two bases
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
